name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, both campaigns together spent $42.10 across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, but produced no leads.
points: Dedicated night runs carried all the activity: $42.10 spent, 2,300 impressions, 19 clicks, and a click rate of 0.8%, but no leads, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Regional Class A — Joliet served no impressions and recorded no clicks or leads, spending $0.00 for the day.
Month-to-date in 2026-11, all $42.10 in spend has run through Meta, with 28 days still remaining in the month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) is mature: 33 were contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 were lost after conversion (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is also mature: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).

The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge, so no rates are shown; qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
